name: dynoxide
description: A DynamoDB emulator with an MCP server exposing 35 DynamoDB tools to coding agents.
long_description:
A DynamoDB emulator that starts in milliseconds, giving coding agents a real local DynamoDB to work against.

**35 tools** covering tables, items, query and scan, batch and transactional writes, PartiQL, secondary indexes, TTL and vector search. Snapshot and restore let an agent set up a fixture, experiment against it, and roll back.

Runs as a single native binary backed by SQLite, with no JVM or Docker required. Verified against real AWS by a public conformance suite.
